North Korea Reshuffles Military Leadership, Dismisses Defence Minister

North Korea has dismissed its defence minister, Kang Sun-nam, as part of a reshuffle of its military leadership. The exact reasons for the dismissal were not immediately clear, but the move was described as a 'structural reorganization'. Kang Sun-nam had held the position of Minister of People's Armed Forces since February 2024. This reshuffle indicates a change in the country's military command structure.
